question: The Union Government of India launched the PM SVANidhi scheme in June 2020 for the benefit of:
solution:
The correct answer is__** ​street vendors.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs** started a scheme PM Street Vendor's **Atma Nirbhar Nidhi** to empower **Street Vendors.**
 
• By not only extending loans to them but also for their **holistic development and economic improvement**.
 
• Through the scheme, **budget collateral-free loans** are provided to** street vendors.**
 
• 'PM SVANidhi' scheme was started on** 1 June 2020**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Small scale industry loan** is an unsecured form of credit that you can take from a lender to fulfil many business objectives.
 
• **Agriculture Loan** can be availed by individual farmers busy in agriculture that cover **Poultry, Fishery, Dairy, Animal Husbandry, etc. **
 
• **Migrant labour,** informal and untrained workers who move about completely from one region to another offering their services on a temporary, **generally seasonal, basis.**
